propositions: Six duplicate reconciler-imported Jira comments exist across three tickets, each with one preexisting survivor and one rollout-created duplicate to be deleted
Manifest builder must validate exact two-live-copy pre-cleanup state, emit Jira cleanup actions, and bind normalized comment bodies with deterministic incident authority

Jira cleanup tool must operate GET-only by default with explicit digest-bound execution, log all attempts in canary order (REB-2605/REB-1931/REB-1567), and verify survivor/non-target parity before and after
Local Git history rewriter must remove only manifest-enumerated COMMENT/snapshot material plus epoch transformation while preserving six survivors and all unrelated paths

Coordinated runbook must disable GitHub Actions reconciler, prove disabled state with no queued runs, freeze both systems, execute exact-six Jira cleanup, perform two unchanged dry-run observations, replace clones, then re-enable only after verification
Preparation phase must not mutate Jira, disable workflows, pause writers, update authoritative refs, or publish leases; execution belongs to separate ticket after all gates pass
